did: Landed KPLAY's four kplay branches as bucket #3597 (closing #2852), placed the shop's stores in the assurance ledger (#3605), then built the phone's half of KP4's shop as bucket #3611 (closing #3596). The shop is a door on "What are you hungry for?" that opens a screen where the owner types or says, in English, what they want to say, and sees the shelf's phrases for it with the parts each is built from, and fills a basket for the visit. A typed hunch is looked up on home (POST /phrases/lookup); one home didn't answer is kept in an outbox the Practice drain sends again and counts as waiting. A spoken hunch is a take of a new voice kind, hunch, carried home by the voice lane, heard there through fast-track, then looked up; home now looks up every hunch it hears (server#1266). Outcomes are said as notices over the screen; words are cut to home's 200-character bound. A ui-fit phone fixture sweeps the shop's states. Reviews found and fixed, among others, a reused hunch name after a take kept as the screen went, a long spoken hunch refused by home, a screen stuck on looking after a remount, and a lan build broken by an import of a phone-only package.

calls.title: Where a hunch home didn't answer is kept until home has it (C1595)
options: keep it in an outbox the Practice drain sends again
a lane of its own for the shop's hunches
say on the screen that a hunch not sent is let go
calls.why: Never lose the record: what the owner typed needs a durable copy, and the Practice drain already runs for the phone's own records, so the outbox is one more part of it rather than a new lane.
calls.undo: Drop the hunches part from the drain and the outbox in lib/shop-home; the screen would then have to say an unsent hunch is let go.

calls.title: How a spoken hunch reaches home (C1596)
options: a take of a new voice kind hunch, carried by the voice lane and heard on home
the shop's port takes the recorded audio and sends it itself
the phone's own recognizer, keeping no take
calls.why: The phone already keeps takes in desks on the take pattern and the voice lane is their durable outbox, so a spoken hunch joins that family instead of a second way to send audio.
calls.undo: Remove hunch from the voice kinds with its desk, voice-copy rows, fast-track and hear; the shop then offers no microphone.

left: #3612: make www's omit-off-path-public-files plugin skip a missing dist, so a failed vite build shows its real error (it hid this bucket's audience-rule refusal).
The shop's copy could now say a spoken hunch's words will be looked up, since home does that itself after server#1266; a story for after this bucket.
Practice's lane words ('session, reflection or ask') name fewer kinds than it counts, hunches included; left as it was.
The hunch outbox is a third kept-list-with-listeners store beside scene-ask's and reflections'; a shared helper is left for later.
A quick remount during a look-up sends it twice; home keeps a miss once per name, so it only costs a request.
